sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "companies" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'localOnly', "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "legal_name" TEXT NULL, "registration_number" TEXT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "email" TEXT NULL, "address" TEXT NULL, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "timezone" TEXT NOT NULL, "logo_path" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "admin_users" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'localOnly', "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "company_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES companies (id), "username" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), "last_login_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("company_id", "username"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "employees" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'localOnly', "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "company_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES companies (id), "employee_number" TEXT NOT NULL, "first_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "middle_name" TEXT NULL, "last_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "email" TEXT NULL, "job_title" TEXT NULL, "employment_status" TEXT NOT NULL, "employment_start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "employment_end_date" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("company_id", "employee_number"), CHECK (employment_end_date IS NULL OR employment_end_date >= employment_start_date));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "employee_rates" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'localOnly', "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "employee_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES employees (id), "rate_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "effective_from" TEXT NOT NULL, "effective_to" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("employee_id", "effective_from"), CHECK (amount_minor > 0), CHECK (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to >= effective_from));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "credentials" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "admin_user_id" TEXT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES admin_users (id), "employee_id" TEXT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES employees (id), "secret_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_temporary" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_temporary" IN (0, 1)), "failed_attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "locked_until" TEXT NULL, "changed_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK ((admin_user_id IS NULL) <> (employee_id IS NULL)), CHECK (failed_attempts >= 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "audit_log" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "company_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES companies (id), "actor_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "actor_id" TEXT NULL, "action" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NULL, "occurred_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "metadata" TEXT NULL, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'localOnly', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "device_identity" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attendance_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'localOnly', "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "employee_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES employees (id), "event_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "recorded_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attendance_settings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'localOnly', "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "company_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES companies (id), "duplicate_window_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "stale_open_session_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "excessive_duration_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "break_after_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "break_minutes" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (duplicate_window_minutes >= 0), CHECK (stale_open_session_minutes > 0), CHECK (excessive_duration_minutes > 0), CHECK ((break_after_minutes IS NULL) = (break_minutes IS NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attendance_corrections" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'localOnly', "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "employee_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES employees (id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "event_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "original_event_id" TEXT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES attendance_events (id), "replacement_event_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES attendance_events (id), "previous_occurred_at" TEXT NULL, "new_occurred_at" TEXT NULL, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "corrected_by" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES admin_users (id), "corrected_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (original_event_id IS NOT NULL OR replacement_event_id IS NOT NULL));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "device_settings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kiosk_company_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES companies (id), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (id = 'this_device'));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exception_reviews" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'localOnly', "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "company_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES companies (id), "employee_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES employees (id), "issue_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "issue_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "event_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES attendance_events (id), "session_key" TEXT NULL, "issue_occurred_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "reviewed_by" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES admin_users (id), "reviewed_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "related_correction_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES attendance_corrections (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "work_schedules" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'localOnly', "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "company_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES companies (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "late_tolerance_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "early_departure_tolerance_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "break_after_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "break_minutes" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("company_id", "name"), CHECK (late_tolerance_minutes >= 0), CHECK (early_departure_tolerance_minutes >= 0), CHECK ((break_after_minutes IS NULL) = (break_minutes IS NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "work_schedule_days" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "schedule_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES work_schedules (id), "weekday" INTEGER NOT NULL, "start_minute" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_minute" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("schedule_id", "weekday"), CHECK (weekday BETWEEN 1 AND 7), CHECK (start_minute BETWEEN 0 AND 1439), CHECK (end_minute BETWEEN 0 AND 1439), CHECK (start_minute <> end_minute));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "schedule_assignments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'localOnly', "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "employee_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES employees (id), "schedule_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES work_schedules (id), "effective_from" TEXT NOT NULL, "effective_to" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("employee_id", "effective_from"), CHECK (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to >= effective_from));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payroll_settings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'localOnly', "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "company_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES companies (id), "daily_overtime_after_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "weekly_overtime_after_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "overtime_percent" INTEGER NOT NULL, "standard_day_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "standard_week_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (overtime_percent BETWEEN 100 AND 400), CHECK (standard_day_minutes > 0), CHECK (standard_week_minutes > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payroll_periods" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'localOnly', "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "company_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES companies (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "end_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (end_date >= start_date));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payroll_adjustments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'localOnly', "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "period_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES payroll_periods (id), "employee_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES employees (id), "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES admin_users (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (amount_minor > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payroll_runs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "sync_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'localOnly', "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "period_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES payroll_periods (id), "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "calculated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "calculated_by" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES admin_users (id), "approved_at" TEXT NULL, "approved_by" TEXT NULL REFERENCES admin_users (id), "finalized_at" TEXT NULL, "finalized_by" TEXT NULL REFERENCES admin_users (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payroll_lines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "run_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES payroll_runs (id), "employee_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES employees (id), "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "regular_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL, "overtime_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL, "regular_pay_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "overtime_pay_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "allowances_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "bonuses_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deductions_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "gross_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "net_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("run_id", "employee_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payroll_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "line_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES payroll_lines (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rate_type" TEXT NULL, "rate_minor" INTEGER NULL, "seconds" INTEGER NULL, "days" INTEGER NULL, "percent" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payroll_run_issues" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "run_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES payroll_runs (id), "employee_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES employees (id), "code" TEXT NOT NULL, "message" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX audit_log_company_time ON audit_log (company_id, occurred_at)
CREATE INDEX audit_log_entity ON audit_log (entity_type, entity_id)
CREATE INDEX attendance_events_employee_time ON attendance_events (employee_id, occurred_at)
CREATE INDEX attendance_events_time ON attendance_events (occurred_at)
CREATE INDEX attendance_corrections_original ON attendance_corrections (original_event_id)
CREATE INDEX attendance_corrections_employee ON attendance_corrections (employee_id, corrected_at)
CREATE INDEX exception_reviews_issue ON exception_reviews (issue_key)
CREATE INDEX exception_reviews_company_time ON exception_reviews (company_id, issue_occurred_at)
CREATE INDEX payroll_periods_company_start ON payroll_periods (company_id, start_date)
CREATE INDEX payroll_adjustments_period ON payroll_adjustments (period_id)
CREATE INDEX payroll_runs_period ON payroll_runs (period_id)
CREATE INDEX payroll_lines_run ON payroll_lines (run_id)
CREATE INDEX payroll_lines_employee ON payroll_lines (employee_id)
CREATE INDEX payroll_items_line ON payroll_items (line_id)
CREATE INDEX payroll_run_issues_run ON payroll_run_issues (run_id)
